description: Give a product link (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy…). If it is one of our picks, returns that deal and our verdict. Otherwise checks the price from an authorised source (Amazon’s API, or the shop’s own page) and, for Amazon, Keepa’s 90-day record of Amazon’s own price, then applies fixed rules: sent_to_editors, needs_review, turned_down or unverifiable. Never guesses a price; nothing is published without an editor.
name: check_deal_url
title: Check a product link against PostThisDeal’s Deal Room
